interest: the submarine entire — hull form, battery, the closed-cycle plant, the reload gear, the depth
the search sensors — the hydrophone array, the ship radar and the aero search radar, because a fleet that cannot see cannot strangle trade and every other line is subordinate to that one
the marine diesel. NOT SUPPORTING: an 8,000 bhp group in 1926 is +4 on the 10,000 bhp Burmeister & Wain units of Britannic (1930), and +4 does not fit a +2/+3 band
the torpedo. NOT SUPPORTING: a pattern-running gyro in 1938 is +4 on the real FaT of late 1942, and the boat's own weapon does not sit in a shallower band than the boat
supporting: the warning receivers — FuMB C/38 in 1940 is +2 on Metox (fitted from August 1942); FuMB C/42 in 1944 is a year BEHIND Naxos (September 1943)
the directors. NOT PAR: C/29 in 1931 is +3 on the German SL-1 of 1934 and on the American Mark 33 of the same year, and +3 is not par
par: guns and mounts of every caliber. ⚠ THE 28 CM IS PAR TO THREE SIGNIFICANT FIGURES: the real 28 cm SK C/28 was in service 1930 at 300 kg and 910 m/s to 36,475 m, which is [de30gun] to three significant figures. The 8.8 cm boat mount's ballistics are the SK L/45 of 1906. The 37 mm is the Bofors L/60 (design complete October 1933, first order August 1934) and not one round a minute faster. The 2 cm C/37 is the real 2 cm/65 C/38 of 1940 on rate and magazine alike

the aero engines — 850 hp in 1933 is the top of the real 1933–35 radial band and no more. ⚠ THE AIRFRAMES ARE COLD AND THE ENGINE IS NOT, AND THAT IS THE DESIGN: a par engine dragging a deliberately slow airframe is what makes the reconnaissance gap arithmetic
cold: aircraft performance — two airframes in the whole navy, both slow, both barely armed. They are sensor platforms with wings and nothing else
heavy-gun and armor DEVELOPMENT, which stopped being a German program in 1922
the drop tank [de40tnk], whose capacity leaves the search radius short of the ocean the raiders work

⚠ ONE GENERATION INSIDE AN INTEREST LINE IS COLD ON PURPOSE: [de44rad] arrives AFTER the British Type 271 (1941) and the American SG (1942). An interest line may hold a cold generation; this one is opening decision §6.8, and it is a design statement, not a defect
calibration.notes: The submarine and its search sensors run deep; everything above water is absent rather than behind. Every generation in this file is checked against the best real-world article at any date in the window, and no figure exceeds one. The distribution IS the scenario: a navy that bought one thing and did not buy a surface fleet at all.

common.note: It outranges every cruiser afloat and will not trouble a battleship, which is the whole of its doctrinal fit. A battery that could tempt a captain into a second opinion would be a defect.

A ship which cannot afford two secondary batteries must not be given a choice between them. The only gun on a raider that expects to be fired in anger, and the only one aboard that the doctrine admits may have to save the ship.

Sealed rather than dried out, so it can be manned within a minute of surfacing and left flooded for the rest of the patrol. The first thing the crews stop using once air cover reaches the convoy lanes — which is a statement about the enemy's program rather than about the gun.

common.mountings: twin, single and quadruple on one foundation ring
common.note: The 1937 gunnery trials found the thirty-seven could not engage anything flying faster than the airplane it had been specified against. The replacement is NOT a development of it, and it replaces nothing — it is simply added wherever there is a ring, because a raider that is found by aircraft is a raider that has run out of arguments.

The one industrial line in this navy that leads the world rather than following it. The 1926 unit went to sea in a Finnish-built boat before it went to sea in a German one, which is the whole history of this navy in a sentence. Specific consumption is the figure the staff quote rather than output: on a hull whose bunker is also its cargo, fuel burned is fuel not given away.

lines.name: Storage battery

common.replacement: deck-hatch, one group at a time, without cutting the pressure hull
common.note: Nineteen years of cell work in a design office with no submarines to fit them to, funded on a commercial traction contract that was never entirely fictitious. The only component in this navy specified by ENERGY PER TON rather than by output, because a submarine's endurance underwater is a weight problem and nothing else. The 1941 cell IS the Elektroboot.

generations.notes: THE ELEKTROBOAT'S CELL: drawn C/39, in the water 1941. 73 percent better than [de27bat] in the same weight, NOT four times - the four-fold figure belongs to the BOAT (5.71 kWh per ton submerged against 1.71), and the rest of it is a naval architect who gave the battery the hull instead of the other way round.

lines.notes: Nineteen years of cell work in a design office with no submarines to fit them to, funded on a commercial traction contract that was never entirely fictitious. THE CELL IS THE ONLY COMPONENT IN THIS NAVY SPECIFIED BY ENERGY PER TON RATHER THAN BY OUTPUT, because a submarine's endurance underwater is a weight problem and nothing else. Groups replace through a deck hatch, one at a time, without cutting the pressure hull. A bat code lives in the class sheet's `battery` row and nowhere else - never in sensors, never as a batteries[] weapon, never in possible_upgrades.

common.note: Passive, and the only sensor line in this navy that was ahead of everybody else's from the beginning rather than behind. The training establishment predates the first set by three years and was the more expensive of the two. It hears a convoy long before anything sees one, which is what a fleet with almost no airplanes over the middle of the ocean needs it to do.

generations.notes: PASSIVE RANGING TO FIRING ACCURACY: a boat fires on the array alone, with no periscope raised. THIS IS THE PRECONDITION FOR THE ELEKTROBOAT - a hull that must show a periscope to shoot is not a boat that never comes up. The scanning transmitter is fitted and the boats are ordered not to use it.

WITHDRAWN: this generation does NOT find depth. No passive array of the period found depth and the real Balkon-Gerat of 1943 gave BEARING ONLY. The 40 km is a CONVOY figure and the 12 km a single-ship figure.

common.note: The earliest line in the catalog and the one nobody expected. The fleet's surface officers regarded it as a liability on the grounds that anything which transmits is a beacon for something that does not; the submarine staff took the opposite view and took the sets.

generations.notes: . The airborne centimetric set marinised. Its gain is RESOLUTION, not range: 60 cm cannot separate a conning tower from the sea return around it and 9 cm can. It does NOT close the countermeasure gap - the British set of this kind was at sea in 1941 and the American in 1942, so the line reopens two to three years behind and after the years in which the trade campaign is decided. de-nothing-above-water-scenario.md SS5.3 owns the ruling; SS6.8 owns the choice that moves the date.

common.note: THE PIECE OF EQUIPMENT THE WHOLE THESIS TURNS ON. The problem was never the transmitter but the return from the sea itself; what solved it was flying low and accepting a narrow beam. A convoy at ninety kilometers in cloud, at night, or in weather that grounds everything else is a convoy that can be reported to a patrol line four hundred kilometers away, and reporting is the entire contribution the air arm was built to make.

Development began the year the laboratory's own sets went to sea, on the reasoning that anybody clever enough to build one would be clever enough to build another — which is a rare thing for a service to fund against itself. It listens for the set that is looking, and says nothing. Warning at half again the emitting set's own detection range is the margin between a boat that dives and a boat that is attacked.

Drawn for the raider and fitted nowhere else, because nothing else in the navy has a battery worth directing. The whole installation lifts out as one article and a second trunnion aft takes it if the forward tower is lost. Surface and air on the same gears, which is less an achievement than an admission: a raider is not expected to have two fire-control problems at once.

common.overhaul: at sea from a ship's workshop
common.note: Chosen for a search airplane on the grounds that its consumption at cruise mattered more than its power at altitude — the only sensible way to choose an engine for an aircraft whose mission is to stay up. Overhaul is done aboard by ratings who are not aviation specialists, and the design was frozen against that requirement rather than against a performance one.

Every boat drawn since 1929 already carries the trunk foundation, which is why this is a kit and not a design change — the provision habit reached the submarine line eleven years before the fitting existed. It converts the diesel from a thing that must be run on the surface into a thing that can be run anywhere, and it is the difference between a boat that is safe at night and a boat that is safe.

lines.name: Torpedo

common.note: The one round the whole navy fires: a raider's fixed tubes, an ocean boat's six, an Elektroboot's outfit and the sixty in a tender's after hold are the same weapon from the same crate. One weapon, one magazine, one drill book and one stockpile — the only economy this navy has been able to afford, and the reason a boat can be stored from a merchant hull in an anchorage.

generations.notes: THE INFLUENCE PISTOL WORKS, AND THERE IS NO FAILURE PERIOD OR RELIABILITY PENALTY ON ANY GERMAN WEAPON IN THIS SCENARIO. The Inspectorate that proofed it was funded through the flat decade on one of the few lines the prohibition left open, and it fired against moving hulls before issue. de-nothing-above-water-scenario.md section 5.2 owns the ruling.

lines.notes: One weapon, one magazine, one drill book and one stockpile is the only economy this navy could afford, and it is the reason a boat can be stored from a merchant hull in an anchorage. Both pistols work: see SS5.2 of the scenario file.

common.note: Carried by the raiders and by both search aircraft, and by nothing else, because nothing else in this navy hunts submarines. Its effect depends entirely on how well the dropper knows where the target is, which on both platforms is not very well.

common.rails: removable, shipped or landed in a forenoon
common.note: Opportunistic rather than programmatic: a raider that has been chased off a shipping route can leave something behind on it, and a hundred and twenty mines in a focal area is a cheaper way of closing it for a fortnight than staying there would be.

spec.unit: magnetic influence, in the same case and on the same rails

common.fits: the outboard underwing racks, two per aircraft
common.note: THE AIRPLANE IT DOES NOT FIT IS THE POINT. The reconnaissance gap - one search type, 615 km, no radar, one deck - stayed open 1933-40, and NOT because the tank did not exist. The Seeschwalbe's underwing racks were rated in 1931 for a 50 kg bomb, nobody re-rated them, and a full tank is four times that. THE GAP STAYED OPEN BECAUSE OF A RACK.
